assets.subject: s3_rome.cover
assets.description: Season cover (portrait, as London's and Paris's): Rome at golden hour from the Capitoline Hill, a broken marble map piece on the ledge in front, a small owl on a column.
assets.prompt: A tall portrait view over Rome at golden hour, seen from a stone terrace on the Capitoline Hill: warm stone buildings, red-tiled roofs, church domes and the ruins of the ancient Forum glowing in low sunlight, filling the middle of the picture. In front, on the stone ledge of the terrace, lies a broken grey marble slab carved with the lines of old streets, one corner missing, a little left of centre; a small owl sits on a broken column on the right of the ledge, looking out over the city. Calm, mysterious, inviting. Composition for a phone screen: the upper third is open evening sky with no important detail; the city and its domes fill the middle; the slab and the owl sit in the lower middle, above a plain strip of stone along the bottom edge; keep everything important within the central two-thirds of the width, with only sky, stone and soft rooftops near the left and right edges.
notes: Portrait: the game's covers are portrait paintings (London 941x1672, Paris 941x1671) shown by BoxFit.cover. 1024x1536 is the API's portrait size; the game shows it as it is (no resize).

Safe area on the 1024x1536 picture: the season board fills the phone (9:16 shows x 80-944; a 9:20 phone x 170-854) and pushes in up to 1.165x; the title stands over the top 30% (y 0-460) and the button over the bottom ~15% (y 1300-1536). Key subjects: x 170-854, y 460-1300. The archive strip shows one 2:1 band (1024x512, archiveLook), the World Map thumbnail nearly the whole width.
Wiring: one SeasonCover line in lib/widgets/art_assets.dart, its crop, push and archiveLook chosen on the drawn picture (STEP 3-12C).

assets.subject: s3_rome.map
assets.description: The season's map of central Rome for the mission pins: the river, the hills and the season's eleven places as small drawn landmarks.
assets.prompt: An illustrated bird's-eye map of central Rome on warm paper: the curving river Tiber with a boat-shaped island, the Capitoline Hill, the Roman Forum and Colosseum, the round Pantheon, the Trevi Fountain, the Spanish Steps, Piazza Navona's long oval, a market square and a small quiet square with a crane. Small hand-painted landmark drawings, winding streets, no labels and no writing of any kind.
notes: Pin positions in the case plans (mapX, mapY) are placeholders until this map is drawn and its landmarks measured.

assets.subject: s3_rome.prologue
assets.description: Season prologue background: the museum's map hall at dawn, an empty glass case lit by the first sun.
assets.prompt: A grand marble museum hall at dawn, tall windows letting in pale gold light. In the centre stands an empty glass display case on a stone stand, a soft beam of sunlight falling on it. Old statues line the walls in shadow. Quiet and puzzling, not frightening.

assets.prompt: A small guard room inside an old Roman museum: a wooden desk with an open log book and a thermos of coffee, a guard's cap on a hook, a grey metal light box with a big lever switch on the stone wall, a doorway to a dark marble hall. Early morning light through a small window.

assets.subject: s3_rome.map_hall
assets.description: The Capitoline map hall: the glass case, a big statue, stairs and a back door; reused for the season's last scene.
assets.prompt: A marble exhibition hall in the Capitoline Museums, seen straight from the front, warm daylight from tall windows high on the back wall. Layout from left to right: on the far left, a museum visitor map board on a wooden stand, about a sixth of the width, its panels blank; left of centre, an empty glass display case on a stone stand; just right of centre, a large white marble statue of a Roman senator wrapped in a long toga, on a low base; on the right, a short flight of stone stairs going down towards the lower right; at the foot of the stairs, on the far right, a heavy wooden back door, with a small white card lying on the floor right at its foot. A faint trail of white dust runs from the glass case, past the statue's foot, down the stairs to the door. A polished marble floor across the bottom of the picture.
notes: STEP 3-14: Case 01 M3 is a look round this picture (map board far left, case, statue, stairs, back door with the card far right). Its areas in the case plan follow this layout and are measured on the made picture (STEP 3-15).
STEP 3-15B: "classical statue" was refused by the API safety filter (B1); now a senator in a long toga.

assets.subject: s3_rome.trevi_fountain
assets.description: The Trevi Fountain: rushing water, stone shells on the basin's edge, wide steps.
assets.prompt: The Trevi Fountain in Rome on a bright morning: a great white stone palace front with statues in long flowing robes and rushing turquoise water, carved stone shells along the edge of the basin, wide stone steps in front where a few people sit. In the front, a girl with her back to the fountain throws a coin over her shoulder into the water. Coins glint in the water.
notes: STEP 3-14: also a choice picture of Case 01 M3 (where people throw coins and make a wish): the girl throwing a coin must be easy to see.
STEP 3-15B: statues in long flowing robes (map_hall was refused by the API safety filter over a statue).

assets.subject: s3_rome.flower_market
assets.description: Campo de' Fiori market: a flower stall with a red roof and numbered wooden boxes; crates of lemons.
assets.prompt: A lively morning market square in old Rome, Campo de' Fiori. On the left, vegetable stalls under white umbrellas, with crates of lemons and artichokes; in the middle distance, the tall dark hooded statue on its stone base; ochre and terracotta buildings around the square. On the right, in front, a flower stall with a red roof, full of red roses in metal buckets, with a row of small wooden storage boxes under the counter. Standing behind the flower stall's counter is its owner, Pia: a cheerful, round Italian woman in her sixties with grey hair, rosy cheeks, a red scarf over her hair and a flowered apron, waving a hand. She is the only person behind the flower stall; no young man works there.
notes: STEP 3-15B B2: made again (user approved, 1 call, $0.10): the B1 picture showed a young man as the flower seller. Pia (sixties, flowered apron, red scarf, as her portrait prompt) now stands behind her own stall; the layout (vegetables left, statue in the middle, the red-roofed stall front right) is the B1 picture's. The B1 picture is kept in asset_work/s3_rome/superseded/flower_market_v1_96be0f43eeb6c9a5/.

assets.subject: s3_rome.pantheon_hall
assets.description: Inside the Pantheon: the dome's open eye, a circle of sunlight on the patterned stone floor.
assets.prompt: Inside the Pantheon in Rome, seen from near the door: a huge round hall under a coffered dome, with the round open eye of the dome at the top centre. A bright circle of sunlight lies on the patterned marble floor, left of centre. Tall columns and niches stand around the walls; the great bronze door is on the far right. In front of the door, on the right, a wooden bench with a small white card on it. Along the bottom of the picture, a row of four large round carved stones set into the floor, evenly spaced from left to right, their carvings too small to make out. Calm and full of light.
notes: STEP 3-14: Case 04 M1 is a look round this picture (the eye, the circle of light, the bench with the card, the four floor stones along the bottom), and Case 01 M3 shows it as a choice picture (the round hole in the roof must be easy to see).

assets.prompt: A tiny old bookshop in Rome with shelves of worn books up to the ceiling, a wooden counter with a brown paper parcel tied with string and an old brass weighing scale. Through the window, the columns of the Pantheon across a sunny square. The book spines are plain, with no writing.

assets.subject: s3_rome.cat_ruins
assets.description: Largo di Torre Argentina: sunken Roman temple ruins below street level, cats on warm stones.
assets.prompt: Largo di Torre Argentina in Rome: the ruins of old temples in a sunken square below the street, a row of broken columns across the upper middle, old stone floors among grass. In the lower left, a small wooden notice board on a post with a blank paper pinned to it, and two cat food bowls on a flat stone beside it. In the middle and on the right, three cats asleep on warm stones: an orange cat with a long fluffy tail, an orange cat with a short tail and white dust on its paws, and a black cat with a long tail. Railings and buildings at street level along the top. Warm afternoon light.
notes: STEP 3-14: Case 05 M1 is a look round this picture (the board and bowls lower left, the temples, the three cats). The cats here match the three choice pictures (cat_rosso, cat_tito, cat_luna).

assets.subject: s3_rome.cast_workshop
assets.description: The Bassi plaster workshop: white statues and moulds, a big wall mirror, a cabinet of small drawers.
assets.prompt: A plaster cast workshop in an old Roman street, seen from just inside its open doorway. On the left, the doorway opens onto a sunny cobbled street with ochre houses and old stone columns. In the middle, tall wooden shelves of white plaster busts, lion heads and shells. On the right, a large old gilt mirror on the wall and a wooden cabinet with many small drawers without readable numbers. In the foreground, a long wooden work table with blue-grey rubber moulds and a plaster lion relief, white dust in the sunlight. Tito the cat sits on the right end of the table, seen from the side: an orange short-haired tabby with a very short, stubby tail, only a small stump, clearly much shorter than a normal cat's tail, and white plaster dust on its paws.
notes: STEP 3-15A wrap-up: drawn again once (the first picture's cat had a long fluffy tail, against Case 05's clue 'short tail'). The prompt keeps the first picture's layout in words; the first picture is kept in content_pipeline/asset_work/s3_rome/superseded/.

assets.prompt: Inside an old Roman bath: a large room with a big rectangular pool of blue-green water, columns around it, stone benches along the walls, soft light from high windows. No shelves, no holes in the walls, no rows of seats.

assets.subject: s3_rome.room_theatre
assets.description: A choice picture of Case 09 M1: a Roman theatre, a THEATRUM (a wrong answer).
assets.prompt: An old Roman theatre in the open air: a half-round of stone seats rising in rows around a flat stage, broken columns behind the stage, umbrella pines and blue sky. No pool and no holes in the walls.

assets.subject: s3_rome.helmet_white_crane
assets.description: A choice picture of Case 10 M1: a worker's white helmet with the crane sticker (a wrong answer).
assets.prompt: The same hook, view and light as the reference helmet, but the safety helmet is white, with the same small crane sticker on the front. Its inside is not seen.

assets.subject: s3_rome.helmet_yellow_plain
assets.description: A choice picture of Case 10 M1: a visitor's plain yellow helmet (a wrong answer).
assets.prompt: The same hook, view and light as the reference helmet, the same yellow colour, but with no sticker or picture of any kind on it. Its inside is not seen.

assets.subject: s3_rome.stone_lion
assets.description: A choice picture of Case 11 M1: Stone A, grey marble carved with a lion (a wrong answer).
assets.prompt: A broken piece of grey-white marble slab, the same size, colour and view as the reference, but carved with a lion's head instead of street lines. No owl and no crack.

assets.subject: s3_rome.stone_street
assets.description: A choice picture of Case 11 M1: Stone B, grey marble with street lines but no owl and no crack (a wrong answer).
assets.prompt: A broken piece of grey-white marble slab, the same size, colour and view as the reference, carved with thin street lines and small rooms, but with no owl and no crack anywhere.

assets.subject: s3_rome.owl_reveal
assets.description: Special scene: the Owl lowers her hood on the Bridge of Four Heads at evening.
assets.prompt: On the old stone bridge to Tiber Island at evening, beside a stone post carved with four faces, the young woman Livia lowers the hood of her grey coat and holds out a small white owl card. Golden light on the river behind her. A quiet, moving moment.
